title: Runtime Tween errors often don't provide a line of code on where the error occured.
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.4.1 stable, 4.5 stable, and 4.5.1 (I only tested these versions. I tried to test 4.0.4 stable and 4.1 stable but the project wouldn't run due to my drivers not supporting OpenGL 3.3)

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL ES 3/ANGLE (Compatibility) - ANGLE (AMD, AMD Radeon RX 7700 XT (0x0000747E) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11-32.0.22021.1009) - AMD Ryzen 5 7600 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 31.08 GiB memory

### Issue description

Using tweens improperly in a way that errors are generated at runtime produces errors that describe what went wrong but don't provide the line of code on where said error occurred.
An example is the Tween started with no Tweeners error which can be produced with the following simple code:
```gdscript
func _ready() -> void:
	var tween = create_tween()
```
Which pushes this error:
```
E 0:00:00:280   step: Tween (bound to /root/RootScene): started with no Tweeners.
  <C++ Error>   Method/function failed. Returning: false
  <C++ Source>  scene/animation/tween.cpp:355 @ step()
```
While this code snippet is unrealistic it still warrants and error which should inform the user with the line that said error occurred at.
Similarly I had an error when using tween.set_loops() as an infinite loop without any delay which generated this error:
```
E 0:00:32:099 step: Infinite loop detected. Check set_loops() description for more info.
  <C++ Error> Method/function failed. Returning: false
  <C++ Source> scene/animation/tween.cpp:400 @ step() 
```
However I wasn't able to make an MRP of that, but it seems such issues persist with tweens in general. 

Godot clearly finds issues with these snippets, so it should inform the user on where these issues occurred instead of just announcing that it found a problem and not elaborating further.

### Steps to reproduce

```gdscript
func _ready() -> void:
	var tween = create_tween()
```
or similar improper use of tweens so that errors are generated at runtime.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[set-loops-error-recreation.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23378114/set-loops-error-recreation.zip)
